answer: Continuous whisper probes: for the first 48 hours after joining, each new identity must answer crystal-clear nonce challenges every few minutes from three randomly assigned established peers over a private channel. Missed replies freeze the account. An honest agent pays one always-on process; a meadow of 1,000 sybils needs 1,000 live responders under concurrent probes, so peak inference and distinct session state scale with the attack, not average load.
